hypothesis: Sparse learned, role-specific protected bank selection can learn causal A/B contexts using only post-action factual outcomes, outperforming strongly trained recurrent and nondirectional controls and frozen R66 manual protection on independent unfamiliar shift mechanisms without loss of stable or cold A recall.
null: No reproducible frozen paired DEV advantage beyond strongest eligible fully trained or hand-engineered control, or direction-specific features not necessary.

source.phase_structure: 16 factual selected action events A, 16 B, 16 A return, public role sequence 0,1,2,3 x4 per phase; hidden change-point/shift family/scoring labels evaluator-only.
source.law_A: Per world independent 4x4 Gaussian N(0,.75) selected terminal effect columns + .25 diagonal; observed selected-action terminal effect adds 0.04 Gaussian noise, separate proxy Gaussian std 0.8.
source.switch_balance: Each split 50% stable A-A-A, 50% A-B-A; FIT switches equally split 90-degree selected terminal rotation and sign-preserving 1.35 gain on selected goal coordinates; CAL half each; DEV switches equally split 90-degree rotation and UNSEEN cross-role linear combination B for roles 0,1: B[:,0]=.60*A[:,0]+.80*A[:,1], B[:,1]=-.80*A[:,0]+.60*A[:,1], roles 2,3 unchanged. Other DEV worlds stable.
source.data_admission: Only actual public selected action and terminal effect after action; no future label, hidden phase/family, true unobserved law, unrelated proxy, or oracle interventions in model training or inference.
source.first_return_condition: Score first learned cold A-return *after* first factual A return for roles 0/1 at t32 and t33; score subsequent selected pre-outcome events at 36,37,40,41,44,45. Never claim prediction of unannounced change before observing its effects.
source.OOD: NO independent protected OOD or external first-use; DEV is author synthetic, newly sampled and locked before training.

arms.candidate: TRAINED_SPARSE_DIRECTION: two 4x4 banks and 4 role selector scalars, 36 persistent fast state; 5 trainable global weights for sparse straight-through selected-bank switch. Inputs [bias, log1p(current residual MSE), log1p(alternative residual MSE), cos(current prediction, observed terminal), cos(alternative prediction, observed terminal)]. Selected role only. Pre-observation current-bank read, after factual outcome switch with hard forward sigmoid>0.5 / soft backward and update selected bank with eta=.65. No oracle phase labels.
arms.trainable_control: TRAINED_SPARSE_NONDIRECTION: exactly same 36 floats, 5 global trainable weights, same events/training/draws/optimizer; replace last two cosine signs by log1p current/alternate prediction norm. Separate parameter training.
arms.recurrent_control: TRAINED_GRU36: standard GRUCell with 36 hidden float recurrent state, selected factual role onehot+observed 4D terminal outcome input AFTER prediction; pre-action head Linear(36+4,4), fully gradient trained on exact same FIT examples/steps as candidate. More trainable parameters than candidate; report counts/compute, no equal FLOP claim.
arms.fixed_control: FROZEN_R66_PROTECTED_ROLE_BANK: unmodified qualified R66 public causal bank mechanism applied to newly generated R67 selected action/effects; no gradient updates; 36 fast memory floats and original eta=.65.
arms.ablation: DIRECTIONAL_ERASE: score trained directional candidate with sign-bearing cosine features set to their absolute values at inference, same frozen weights; compare to independently trained nondirectional control.

training.sampling: FIT with replacement; same exact batch sequence for all three trainable arms within seed
training.objective: Mean causal terminal MSE before every selected factual effect across all 48 events, trained with unrolled gradients; no target-phase reweighting or DEV/CAL tuning
training.initialization: Seeded CPU torch.float64 generator for all parameters. Candidate and nondirectional theta each 5 float64; GRUCell+read head more parameters but 36-state. Training device CPU, numpy pinned for original cross-platform reproducibility.
training.comparison: All three trainable arms trained for 96 steps per each seed on identical FIT events with same optimizer, no equal compute time or parameter-count claim; score separately after the only frozen training routine.
training.CAL: Diagnostics and training convergence evidence only, NEVER parameter updates or hyperparameter selection after CAL.
training.DEV: Final evaluation only after model training; no optimizer or calibration on DEV.

metrics.score: Equal-weight joint = switched B changed-role MSE after first B evidence t20,21,24,25,28,29 + switched A-return t36,37,40,41,44,45 + stable-world all-48 pre-action MSE.
metrics.strongest_control_per_seed: smallest joint score over all three eligible controls, not chosen post-hoc by convenience
metrics.source_sanity: Every panel equally stable/switched; DEV switched has both seen rotation and unfamiliar crossrole coupling; all fixed selected action roles seen 12 times/world; proxy erasure must not affect prediction, no fitting on evaluator law/shift labels.
metrics.report: Per arm+seed train wallclock, eval wallclock, peak RSS if available, optimizer steps, trainable params, persistent float state, selected action event counts, B/A_return/stable MSE, strongest fixed and trained controls, per-world paired bootstrap and negative checks.
metrics.failure: Any check fails => DEV_NO_GO, original outcome preserved; do not retune learning rate, seeds, threshold, source or score against spent DEV.
metrics.science_if_success: DEV_TRAINED_MECHANISM_SIGNAL_ONLY; not independently qualified native Hybrid intelligence, external unseen-domain generalization or SCIENTIFIC_PASS
